title: Retained-memory QEC intervention-policy synthesis
difficulty_explanation: Each verifier call contains two 50-data-qubit toric memories, six five-round syndrome histories per case, and three retained-memory process scenarios. A round-sector amplitude coherently sums 2^24 stabilizer-degenerate errors, while action-dependent retained-memory kicks make roundwise greedy correction invalid. The solver must derive the spatial transfer, compose temporal logical-memory instruments, search 5^5 action schedules per history, and solve an exact coupled multiple-choice budget program.
solution_explanation: The constructive expert starts from the cheapest schedule, performs two deterministic coordinate-refinement sweeps, computes every spatial sector amplitude as the trace of a five-virtual-qubit TensorCircuit transfer circuit, composes each retained-memory process instrument, enumerates the exact per-history cost frontier, and combines the frontiers by deterministic dynamic programming under the shared budget.
verification_explanation: The evaluator never imports TensorCircuit. It independently contracts complex128 NumPy row transfers, checks those transfers against direct enumeration of all plaquette fields on an L=3 canary, checks the compact temporal fidelity formula against an explicitly propagated reference-logical-memory Choi state, validates every opaque action and declared metric, rejects schema and finite-value mutations, and derives the exact global optimum.
relevant_experience: This reserve combines coherent stabilizer degeneracy, process-tensor memory, conditional logical channels, robust intervention design, resource-constrained dynamic programming, and framework-native nonunitary transfer contractions.

contract.determinism_scope: Exact cases are bound by the pinned image/runtime and evaluator-emitted full case_digest; the integer seed alone is not a cross-NumPy identity.
contract.case_seed_source: verifier-only ORBIT_Q_CANDIDATE_SEED, legacy ORBIT_PROCESS_TENSOR_QEC_SEED fallback, or evaluator --seed for local canaries
contract.hidden_holdout_status: pending; local host digests are non-binding development canaries and no pinned-image private holdout has been frozen or authorized
contract.anti_hardcoding: The seed changes both cases, all syndrome histories and anchor recoveries, history weights, three process scenarios, every memory-conditioned edge angle and temporal memory rotation, initial memory states, shuffled opaque action IDs, case/history/syndrome IDs, and active budgets. Exact action sequences and continuous objectives are scored.
contract.oracle: Independent complex128 NumPy toric row transfer, separate exhaustive L=3 plaquette enumeration, explicit dense reference-logical-memory Choi propagation, and exact sequence-frontier plus portfolio dynamic programming

seed_protocol.base_seed_mapping: One NumPy Generator stream emits two ordered cases and deterministically retries a case until both the cheapest-to-selected and selected-to-unconstrained objective margins are active.
seed_protocol.determinism_scope: Exact public case bytes are deterministic only under the bound runtime and are identified by the emitted digest.
seed_protocol.case_identity: SHA-256 of canonical JSON with sorted keys, compact separators, and allow_nan false over the two ordered exact cases; stdout emits the full case_digest and protocol_seed in exactly one structured orbit_q_case_identity JSON line.
seed_protocol.seed_scrub: The evaluator removes both seed environment variables and replaces sys.argv with the evaluator program name immediately after emitting case identity and before submitted-solution import.
seed_protocol.pinned_numpy_note: The target image pins NumPy 2.2.6. Trial manifests must bind the full case_digest and image/runtime; local host digests are not authorized trial records.

difficulty_levers: 50 physical data qubits and 2^24 coherent stabilizer representatives per round-sector prohibit dense physical-state or direct coset enumeration
five syndrome-conditioned rounds are linked by a coherent retained memory, so the intervention after one round changes the effective process seen later
three process scenarios produce a per-history worst-case objective rather than one expected-noise schedule
five actions across five rounds produce 3,125 schedules per history, with distinct logical frames, memory back-actions, and costs
six histories share one deliberately active intervention budget, requiring an exact coupled portfolio dynamic program
two sequential verifier-seeded cases, shuffled opaque identifiers, continuous objectives, and a 160-line ceiling discourage positional assumptions and one-off transcription
claim_boundary: This is a deterministic synthetic, perfect-syndrome, history-indexed intervention-portfolio diagnostic. The retained two-level mode and its calibrated action back-actions define an effective bounded-memory process instrument; they are not claimed as a complete microscopic bath. Histories are optimized offline after being supplied, so this is not an online causal decoder, a faulty syndrome-extraction circuit, or a threshold calculation. Local NumPy validation establishes mathematical self-consistency only. The TensorCircuit expert has not run in the pinned image, Harbor has not run, no solver-model trial has run, and no model-hardness claim is made.

local_static_validation.binding_status: non-binding local design canaries only; no listed digest is authorized for a solver trial
local_static_validation.expert_proxy_scope: in-memory dense gate embedding that checks the intended Circuit.unitary/Circuit.matrix algebra; not a TensorCircuit execution or runtime estimate

independent_audit.mathematics: Toric row transfer, plaquette redundancy, logical sectors, retained-memory operator order, Kraus-block probability, and conditional entanglement fidelity independently passed direct-enumeration and dense-Choi checks.
independent_audit.expert_evaluator_parity: A conventional in-memory Circuit composition proxy and a NumPy substitution isolated to the expert spatial amplitude both matched the evaluator at production shape; this is not evidence about the pinned TensorCircuit API or runtime.
independent_audit.hardness_assessment: The task contains genuine finite synthesis, but the prompt states the temporal operators, 5^5 schedule enumeration, and coupled budget dynamic program. Only the spatial row transfer must be derived, and the 146-line expert exhaustively enumerates after its warm start. GPT-5.6 hardness is therefore not plausible enough to authorize a pilot without redesign.
resolved_findings: CLI seed and evaluator arguments are now scrubbed from sys.argv before untrusted import in addition to both seed environment variables.
The probability diagnostic now selects the actual minimum-cost opaque action rather than shuffled action index zero.
The submitted module now receives a deep copy of the exact case config, so in-call mutation cannot alter the verifier's validation inputs.
The advertised 300-second submission limit is now an explicit pass criterion rather than a reporting-only timer.

admission_blockers: Candidate 118 intentionally has no entry in the frozen candidates.jsonl/shortlist and now has an exact-byte post-snapshot design_only registry binding. The safe runner rejects that lifecycle before both expert and model paths; only a future separately hashed, human-reviewed executable-promotion contract may authorize a run. Do not append or remap it into the frozen 1,000-contract snapshot.

Run the expert in the pinned TensorCircuit image and verify nonunitary custom-gate acceptance, arbitrary periodic two-site ordering, Circuit.matrix orientation, complex128 relative accuracy at approximately 1e-39 five-round conditional probabilities, runtime, and peak memory.

Prequalify at least 25 exact pinned-image records with protocol_seed, full case_digest, expert pass logs, positive probability/memory-contrast/tradeoff margins, runtime below 180 seconds, and explicit admission status before authorizing any schedule.
Freeze independent verifier-only holdouts only after human review; do not promote any local host digest in this blueprint into a trial manifest.
Complete authenticated expert-only functional, static-policy, and LLM-policy audits before any solver trial.

Human reviewers must sign the toric edge/star convention, plaquette redundancy factor, logical-sector basis, temporal operator order, action-back-action interpretation, conditional entanglement-fidelity normalization, robust objective, and offline-policy claim boundary.

Independent review has classified the fully stated temporal formulas plus finite 3,125-schedule search as too recipe-exposed for a GPT-5.6 pilot. Hold this version and redesign around an online causal prefix-sharing policy or synthesized reusable contraction program rather than weakening functional gates.
exploitability_risks: Once the sector amplitudes are available, temporal operators are only 8 by 8 and the schedule space is finite; intended difficulty rests on correctly deriving and implementing the stabilizer transfer and the coupled synthesis, so source audit must reject a standalone NumPy spatial replacement.

The prompt states the process-instrument mathematics completely. A strong agent may reproduce it and enumerate schedules; this reserve is scientifically distinct but not presumed model-hard without a protocol-qualified pilot.
Published evaluator, expert, and local canary seeds become contaminated development evidence and cannot establish private model hardness.
numerical_statistical_risks: Five-round conditional probabilities are naturally around 1e-39. They remain far above complex128 underflow, but normalized fidelities can amplify relative contraction error and require pinned-image parity checks.
The exact deterministic scenarios have no sampling uncertainty; robust means max-min over the declared finite scenario set, not a confidence guarantee for an unknown experiment.
NumPy Generator bytes and low-order floating arithmetic can drift across versions, so exact case_digest and pinned NumPy version are mandatory trial identity.
api_risks: Circuit.unitary must accept nonunitary rank-two and rank-four custom Gate tensors even though the method name says unitary.
Circuit.matrix must preserve gate order and return the complete unnormalized transfer operator.
The periodic two-site gate on virtual qubits L-1 and 0 must preserve supplied site ordering.
TensorCircuit backend and dtype settings are process global, and complex128 is required for the tiny unnormalized history amplitudes.
